meta.title: An RFQ awarded to Vendor B with the PO generated
gaps: Sign in as the approver user and approve the submitted award with a remark; the catalog cannot perform another user's login.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as the approver user and approve the submitted award with a remark; the catalog cannot perform another user's login.

plan.title: RFQ Award to Vendor B with PO

steps.note: Open a suitable existing closed RFQ with bids from the buyer's console.
Open the comparison grid and confirm Vendor B is present before awarding.
Award the full quantity to Vendor B and create and submit the award proposal.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.need: sign in as the approver user and approve the submitted award with a remark

steps.note: The approval must be completed by the separate approver account.
Complete the approved award flow and generate the purchase order or orders.
Confirm the generated PO contains the single awarded line with quantity 10.
Return to the events list to verify the awarded event is represented in History.
Confirm the events list rendered without an error.
Switch to the History tab where the completed awarded event should appear.
Confirm the History table contains at least one event after the award and PO flow.
